text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaaaaah!!
That day's Tenno Sho (Spring) was—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Was Win Variation always that 
noticeable!? She had a seriously crazy 
presence out there, right!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: No, or rather—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "Orfevre is... Is that really Orfevre?"

In a sense, it became a race that 
generated huge buzz.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(What? Something feels strange. That 
heat... that goosebump-inducing aura.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (It's gone—?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh......? ...Wh... What is with that 
half-hearted running...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Don't mess around with me!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
What was that?! Don't mess with me! That 
wasn't—that wasn't you at all!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even when it was agonizingly painful— the 
"Orfevre" that I still wanted to surpass 
was...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hot, fierce, and dazzling... something 
that sweeps away everything in this world!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's... that's just how you are! Why 
would you run like that... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I know not. I had no interest.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I will not repeat myself. Silence. Now... 
begone."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...What... is that—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Y-You're making a fool out of me! After 
all the feelings I've poured into you up 
until now...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ... What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Nngh! I-I get it loud and clear! I'm 
not part of your world at all!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Next...! Enter the Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...! —You, entering the Takarazuka 
Kinen...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I-I know it's way out of my league...! But 
right now, none of that matters...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna beat you black and blue for 
sure! Until that gold of yours is 
completely mangled...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So you'd better come at me trying to crush 
me too! You—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: You absolute idiot!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I totally…… blew it, sir…………

I had already heard the gist of what 
happened from a flustered Win Variation.
choice_data_list: Next up is the Takarazuka Kinen, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for deciding on my own...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing her look so indifferent really 
frustrated me... It pissed me off."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No matter what... I just really wanted to 
fire them up.

She reflects on it, but... the Takarazuka 
Kinen, which marks the end of the spring 
season, should fit nicely into her 
rotation.
choice_data_list:
I'm fine! Let's do our best for the 
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it'll work out, but I'm 
gonna give it everything I've got in my 
own way...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...So, the Takarazuka Kinen, huh? I see."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... So that's why your mood suddenly 
improved.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...A tasteless race is utterly boring.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The fruit has been struck, and it has 
ripened. What comes next will surely 
be—supreme.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Go and enjoy yourself to your 
heart's content, Orfe.

And so, our next target race is the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

Through an unexpected turn of events... an 
all-out clash with our archrival, Orfevre, 
was set in motion!
